svg.title: Every failure leaf needs a named detector
svg.desc: A hand-drawn failure taxonomy rooted at 'run does not succeed, 6.5% of 4,200 runs', splitting into a thin blue LOUD branch and a heavy red SILENT branch. Loud leaves - tool timeout 2.1 percent, dependency down 0.3, malformed args 0.4 - each pair with a green detector box. Silent leaves - livelock 1.2 percent, budget exhaustion 0.9, step limit 0.26, contradictory instructions 0.2, confident wrong answer 1.1 - likewise, with livelock ringed and an inset showing three consecutive steps holding the identical three-dot evidence set. A four-bar gauge caps steps, tokens, dollars and wall-clock, and 'just raise max_steps' is struck through beside a runaway run of $18.40 capped to $0.50.
svg.text: Every failure leaf needs a named detector
what we tried, what we found,
